# Part 3: Myeloid cells

## 3.1 Parameters

```{r mc-params}
mc_params <- list(
  resolutions = c(0.6, 0.8, 1.6, 2.4),
  base_res    = c(CSF = 2.4, PBMC = 0.8),
  seed        = c(CSF = 1, PBMC = 1)
)
```

## 3.3 Load and subset

```{r myeloid-cache-check}
myeloid_clustered_output <- file.path(path$objects, "04R_myeloidCells_integrated_clustered.qs")
myeloid_output <- file.path(path$objects, "05R_myeloidCells_xALD.qs")
myeloid_force_recompute <- FALSE
myeloid_cached <- file.exists(myeloid_output) && !myeloid_force_recompute

if (myeloid_cached) {
  myeloidcells_filtered <- qread(myeloid_output)
  message("loaded ", myeloid_output, " (written ", format(file.info(myeloid_output)$mtime), ")")
  for (cmp in names(myeloidcells_filtered)) {
    dd <- unique(myeloidcells_filtered[[cmp]]@meta.data[, c("patient_ID", "diagnosis")])
    message("  ", cmp, ": ", nrow(dd), " donors -- ",
            paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(table(dd$diagnosis)), table(dd$diagnosis)), collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```

```{r, eval=!myeloid_cached}
xALD_filtered <- qread(file.path(path$objects, "03R_xALD_filtered_integrated.qs"))
table(unique(xALD_filtered[[1]]@meta.data[, c("patient_ID", "diagnosis")])$diagnosis)
```

```{r, eval=!myeloid_cached}
myeloidcells <- lapply(xALD_filtered, function(so) subset(so, subset = celltypes %in% "Myeloid Cells"))
rm(xALD_filtered); invisible(gc())
```

## 3.4 Embedding and clustering

### 3.4.1 Elbow plot

```{r, eval=!myeloid_cached}
wrap_plots(lapply(names(myeloidcells), function(x) ElbowPlot(myeloidcells[[x]], ndims = 50) + ggtitle(x)),
           ncol = 2)
```

### 3.4.2 Embedding and clustering

```{r, eval=!myeloid_cached}
set.seed(42)
myeloidcells <- imap(myeloidcells, function(so, ti)
  lineage_cluster(lineage_embed(so), mc_params$resolutions, mc_params$base_res[[ti]], mc_params$seed[[ti]]))
lapply(myeloidcells, function(so) table(so$seurat_clusters))
qsave(myeloidcells, myeloid_clustered_output)
```

```{r mc-seed-stability, eval=!myeloid_cached}
purrr::imap_dfr(myeloidcells, function(so, ti)
  lineage_seed_stability(so, mc_params$base_res[[ti]], mc_params$seed[[ti]]) %>% mutate(tissue = ti, .before = 1))
```

### 3.4.3 Cluster UMAPs

```{r, eval=!myeloid_cached}
for (ti in names(myeloidcells)) for (col in lineage_res_col(mc_params$resolutions))
  print(plot_clusters(myeloidcells[[ti]], col) + labs(subtitle = ti))
```

```{r}
    group_by(patient_ID, diagnosis) %>%
```

## 3.9 Composition

### 3.9.1 Differential abundance (edgeR, NB with log total offset)

```{r myeloid-ab, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5}
par_ab_mc <- list(
  label_col       = "celltype_mc",
  donor_col       = "patient_ID",
  group_col       = "diagnosis",
  compartment_col = "compartment",
  strat_col       = "severity_active",
  ref_group       = "control",
  min_cells       = 5,
  min_samples     = 0.5,
  fdr             = 0.05)
meta_all_mc <- ab_get_meta(myeloidcells_filtered, par_ab_mc$compartment_col)

ab_mc <- list()
for (ti in c("CSF", "PBMC")) {
  ab <- build_abundance_inputs(
    meta_all_mc, compartment_col = par_ab_mc$compartment_col, focus = ti,
    donor_col = par_ab_mc$donor_col, group_col = par_ab_mc$group_col,
    label_col = par_ab_mc$label_col, strat_col = par_ab_mc$strat_col,
    ref_group = par_ab_mc$ref_group, min_cells = par_ab_mc$min_cells,
    min_samples = par_ab_mc$min_samples)
  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ab$sinfo)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
  res <- fit_ab(ab$mat, ab$sinfo, ab$totals, design,
                coef = setdiff(colnames(design), "X.Intercept.")[1], fdr = par_ab_mc$fdr)
  print(knitr::kable(res %>% arrange(FDR) %>% select(celltype, logFC, ci_lo, ci_hi, PValue, FDR), digits = 3,
                     caption = paste("X-ALD vs control,", ti, "— log2 FC in myeloid sub-type proportion")))
  comp <- ab_compositional(ab, res) %>% dplyr::mutate(tissue = ti, .before = 1)
  fig  <- ab_res_for_figure(res, comp)
  print(plot_ab_figure(
    ab$long, fig$res, ab$totals, pal = umap_palette_for(fig_mc_umap, ti, ab$long$celltype),
    title_a = paste0("Per-donor composition (", ti, " myeloid)"),
    title_b_prefix = paste0("X-ALD vs control, ", fig$method),
    y_lab = paste("proportion of", ti, "myeloid cells"),
    fdr = par_ab_mc$fdr, x_lab = fig$x_lab, ci_label = fig$ci_label,
    out_file = file.path(path$graphs_myeloid, paste0("myeloid_per_donor_", fig$method, "_", ti, ".png"))))
  ab_mc[[ti]] <- list(inputs = ab, res = res, comp = comp, res_fig = fig$res, method = fig$method, x_lab = fig$x_lab)
}

store_figure_panels("myeloid", "abundance", abundance_figure_panels(
  ab_mc, umap_fig = fig_mc_umap, ref_group = par_ab_mc$ref_group,
  contrast = "X-ALD vs control", fdr = par_ab_mc$fdr, y_lab = "proportion of myeloid cells"))
```

### 3.9.6 Per-donor composition

```{r}
donor_pct <- purrr::imap_dfr(myeloidcells_filtered, function(so, tissue)
  so@meta.data %>% select(patient_ID, diagnosis, celltype_mc, sev_grp, severity_active) %>% mutate(tissue = tissue)) %>%
  group_by(tissue, patient_ID, diagnosis, sev_grp, severity_active, celltype_mc) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(tissue, patient_ID) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), proportion = n / total) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#### 3.9.6.1 Per-donor and per-group bar charts

```{r}
donor_pct_sev <- donor_pct %>% filter(!is.na(sev_grp)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(SEV_GROUP3_LABELS[as.character(sev_grp)], levels = SEV_GROUP3_LABELS))
grp_fill <- setNames(SEV_GROUP3_COLS, SEV_GROUP3_LABELS)

for (ti in c("CSF", "PBMC")) {
  d <- donor_pct_sev %>% filter(tissue == ti)
  print(ggplot(d, aes(patient_ID, proportion, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") + scale_fill_manual(values = grp_fill) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Cell type proportion", fill = NULL, title = paste("Myeloid composition per donor -", ti)) +
    theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~ celltype_mc))
  ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_myeloid, paste0("barchart_MC_Distribu_pat_", ti, "_patientbased.png")), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  print(ggplot(d, aes(group, proportion, fill = group)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "bar", width = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_fill) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Cell type proportion", title = paste("Myeloid composition by severity group -", ti)) +
    theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ celltype_mc, nrow = 5, scales = "free_y"))
  ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_myeloid, paste0("barchart_MC_Distribu_sev_", ti, "_patientbased.png")), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
}
```

## 3.10 Pseudobulk DEG

```{r myeloid-deg-run}
gs_units_mc <- deg_loo_units(myeloidcells_DEG, names(myeloidcells_DEG), "all_myeloid", "celltype_mc",
                             min_cells = DEG_MIN_CELLS)
deg_all_myeloid <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(gs_units_mc, function(u) {
  message(u$tissue, " / ", u$level, " / ", u$subset)
  flatten_contrasts(run_all_contrasts(u$get()), u$tissue, u$level, u$subset)
}))
deg_all_myeloid <- collect_deg_results(deg_all_myeloid, csv_prefix = file.path(path$tables, "DEG_myeloid"))

deg_all_myeloid %>%
  group_by(tissue, level, subset, comparison) %>%
  summarise(status = dplyr::first(status), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::count(status)

deg_headline_myeloid <- deg_all_myeloid %>% dplyr::filter(status == "ok", !gene_class %in% DEG_MASK_CLASSES)
MYELOID_VOLCANO_CONTRASTS <- deg_report_contrasts()
deg_label <- function(cmp) if (cmp == "xALD_vs_ctrl") "X-ALD vs Control" else deg_contrast_labels[[cmp]]
```

### 3.10.1 Volcano plots

```{r myeloid-volcano-all, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
for (ti in c("CSF", "PBMC")) for (cmp in MYELOID_VOLCANO_CONTRASTS) {
  df <- deg_headline_myeloid %>% dplyr::filter(tissue == ti, level == "all_myeloid", comparison == cmp)
  if (nrow(df) < 5) next
  p <- plot_volcano(df, title = paste("Pseudobulk DEG —", ti, "(", deg_label(cmp), ")"),
                    lfc_col = "log2FC", padj_col = "padj", gene_col = "gene",
                    subtitle = if (is_sev3_comparison(cmp)) SEV_CONFOUND_NOTE else NULL)
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(path$graphs_myeloid, paste0("Volcano_MC_Pseudobulk_DEG_", ti, "_", cmp, ".png")),
         p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
}
```

#### 3.10.1.1 Per cell type

```{r myeloid-volcano-celltype, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
for (ti in c("CSF", "PBMC")) {
  cts <- sort(unique(deg_headline_myeloid$subset[deg_headline_myeloid$tissue == ti & deg_headline_myeloid$level == "celltype"]))
  for (ct in cts) for (cmp in MYELOID_VOLCANO_CONTRASTS) {
    df <- deg_headline_myeloid %>% dplyr::filter(tissue == ti, level == "celltype", subset == ct, comparison == cmp)
    if (nrow(df) < 5) next
    p <- plot_volcano(df, title = paste(ti, "-", ct, "-", deg_label(cmp)),
                      lfc_col = "log2FC", padj_col = "padj", gene_col = "gene",
                      subtitle = if (is_sev3_comparison(cmp)) SEV_CONFOUND_NOTE else NULL)
    print(p)
```

### 3.11.1 Donor covariates

```{r myeloid-gs-covariates}
cov_mc <- lineage_covariates(myeloidcells_DEG)
readr::write_csv(cov_mc, file.path(path$tables, "donor_covariates_myeloid.csv"))
kable_save(cov_mc %>% dplyr::arrange(sev_grp, donor), "donor_covariates_myeloid", caption = "Donor covariates")

confound_status <- function(cov, var) {
  x <- cov[!is.na(cov$severity_active) & !is.na(cov[[var]]), ]
  if (!nrow(x)) return("not assessable")
  tb <- table(x$severity_active, as.character(x[[var]]))
  if (nrow(tb) < 2) return("not assessable (one arm)")
  if (all(rowSums(tb > 0) == 1) && !identical(colnames(tb)[tb[1, ] > 0], colnames(tb)[tb[2, ] > 0]))
    return("complete")
  p <- prop.table(tb, 1)
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(unname(p[1, ]), unname(p[2, ])))) "none" else "partial"
}
for (v in c("hydrocortisone", "lorenzo", "concurrent")) {
  if (all(is.na(cov_mc[[v]]))) next
  print(kable_save(table(group = cov_mc$sev_grp,
                         value = ifelse(is.na(cov_mc[[v]]), "NA", as.character(cov_mc[[v]]))),
                   paste0("covariate_crosstab_", v, "_myeloid"),
                   caption = sprintf("%s by group -- confounding with stage 3 vs 1-2: %s", v, confound_status(cov_mc, v))))
}
cov_mc %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(serum_nfl, age), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable, sev_grp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = sum(!is.na(value)), median = stats::median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                   min = suppressWarnings(min(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   max = suppressWarnings(max(value, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable_save("covariate_continuous_myeloid", digits = 2, caption = "Continuous covariates by group")
```

```{r myeloid-donor-allsets-figures, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 8}
panel_order <- c("sterol", "lipid", "VLCFA", "stress", "immune", "confound", "control")
set_order <- donor_all_mc %>%
  dplyr::distinct(panel, set) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = union(panel_order, unique(panel)))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(panel, set) %>% dplyr::pull(set)
yes_no <- function(x) ifelse(tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c("yes", "y", "true", "1", "ja"), "+",
                             ifelse(is.na(x), "?", "-"))

for (ti in unique(donor_all_mc$tissue)) for (ct in unique(donor_all_mc$celltype[donor_all_mc$tissue == ti])) {
  d <- donor_all_mc %>% dplyr::filter(tissue == ti, celltype == ct, !is.na(sev_grp))

    dplyr::arrange(sev_grp, donor) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lab = sprintf("%s  HC%s LO%s", donor, yes_no(hydrocortisone), yes_no(lorenzo)))

    donor = factor(donor, levels = don$donor, labels = don$lab),

    ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +

                   strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
                   axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank())
  print(p)
  save_umap_fig(p, paste0("geneset_myeloid_donor_heatmap_", ti, "_", sanitize(ct)), path$graphs_myeloid,
                width_mm = FIG_WIDTH_MM[["double"]],
```
